E.name: Black Shield
E.title: Template:Data Morgana/Black Shield
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Black Shield|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Morgana
|skill        = E
|icon         = Black Shield.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied {{tip|champion}} or herself for 5 seconds, which absorbs incoming {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while it holds.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Shield Strength|{{ap|100 to 320}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|26 to 16}}
|cost         = 80
|costtype     = mana
|target range = 800
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Self, Allies
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* ''Black Shield'' will not resist self nor allied {{tip|crowd control}} (including e.g. an allied {{ai|Tempered Fate|Bard}}).
* ''Black Shield'' will not resist {{tip|nearsight}}. {{bug|2|Expectation based on Malzahar Innate and all other crowd control immunities}}
* ''Black Shield'' negates {{tip|crowd control}} effects before any magic damage is absorbed; even if the shield is broken by an enemy dealing enough damage, its associated disables will not apply. [[Shield#Shield_destruction|Shield-destroying effects]] bypass this however, since they destroy the shield before applying their effects.
* Although not considered a ''crowd control'' effect, ''Black Shield'' is special-cased to block {{cais|Test of Spirit|Illaoi}} spirit pull, but does not prevent {{cai|R|Camille}} tether, {{cai|R|Sylas}}, {{cai|W|Tryndamere}}, {{cai|R|Twisted Fate}}. {{bug|2}}
* ''Black Shield'' does not prevent {{ai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}} from attaching. {{bug|2|Expectation based on Malzahar's Void Shift V7.17}}
* ''Black Shield'' takes priority over other sources of {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and those that grant immunity to specific types of crowd control ({{tip|displacement immunity}} and {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}}).
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will take priority over ''Black Shield''.
* ''Black Shield'' will always take priority over regular {{tip|shield|shields}}. If used in conjunction with {{nie|Lifeline}}, the most recently-applied one will have priority however.
* ''Black Shield'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Morgana}} {{tip|shields}} the target allied champion or herself for a few seconds, which absorbs {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while the shield holds.
}}
